title: static-check.py committed with mangled shebang, de-indented comments, and executable bit dropped
location: scripts/static-check.py:1 (chunk hunk @@ -1,4 +1,4 @@ and file mode header)
evidence: Chunk: '-#!/usr/bin/env python3' / '+#!/ usr / bin / env python3'; 'old mode 100755' / 'new mode 100644'; '+# 1. uproject JSON + expected shape' (was '    # 1. ...'); '+# 5. CRLF scan on tracked text files(best - effort : git tracked only)'. HEAD confirmed: '#!/ usr / bin / env python3'; git ls-files -s shows 100644 while compare-golden.sh/local-ci.sh/run-tests-headless.sh are 100755.
detail: Unintended corruption, not a decision: spaces in the shebang break direct ./scripts/static-check.py exec; the lost +x bit is inconsistent with every sibling gate script; gate 3 survives only because local-ci invokes 'python3 scripts/static-check.py'.
recommended_fix: Restore '#!/usr/bin/env python3', re-indent the comments inside main(), and restore the exec bit (git update-index --chmod=+x scripts/static-check.py).

title: verify-capture-geometry.py is invoked by nothing — the r2 geometric check never runs in any pipeline
evidence: verify-capture-geometry.py:2-5: '"""scripts/verify-capture-geometry.py — the capture-pipeline geometry gate.' / 'Verifies a committed T2 frame's geometry (Perkins r2: "add an / endpoint-vs-node-center geometric check to the capture pipeline")'. Repo-wide grep for 'verify-capture' matches only the script itself; local-ci.sh GATES lists exactly 7 gates, none referencing it; docs/agent-playbook.md has no reference.
detail: The tool self-describes as 'the capture-pipeline geometry gate' but no gate, script, or doc invokes it. The r2 road-anchor/dot-offset regression class it detects can still ship with 7/7 gates green — claimed coverage that nothing enforces.
recommended_fix: Wire it into the pipeline: a step in the MCP capture loop (agent-playbook) running it over each committed frame, plus a docs note; or fold a frame check into an existing gate.

title: Golden JSON schema and derived formulas maintained by hand in three code sites
evidence: PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:139: '",\"flow_summary\":{\"spawned\":%d,...' and 143-146: '// spawned = delivered + live (the SAME formula as the spine-check / writer...)'. spine_check.cpp:638: '"flow_summary":{"spawned":%d,...' and 642: 'static_cast<int>(State.Flow.Packets.size()) + State.Score, // spawned = delivered + live'. compare-golden.sh:28: 'KEYS=('.
detail: Key list and the spawned=delivered+live derivation live in two printf writers plus the checker's KEYS; SCHEMA.md documents but enforces nothing. Contained debt — drift fails loud in gate 7 — but every golden change edits three sites.
recommended_fix: Single-source keys/format in one UE-free header (PacketPlumberCore/Public/PP_GoldenJson.h) included by both writers; derive or lint compare-golden.sh KEYS against it.

title: AGENTS.md fixed-tick contract contradicts the gate this diff now enforces (bUseFixedFrameRate)
evidence: AGENTS.md:55-56: '- **Fixed tick:** the sim steps at 20 Hz (ODN-2; `bUseFixedFrameRate` is / pinned in `Config/DefaultEngine.ini`). `PP::Step` is the only sim advance.' Chunk flips the assertion: 'check(ini_kv.get("/Script/Engine.Engine.bUseFixedFrameRate", "").lower() == "false",'.
detail: The diff flips enforcement to False (driver-owns-rate, r2 decision) but the agent contract still states the engine pin. A future agent following AGENTS.md will re-set True and fail gate 3, or misattribute sim-rate ownership.
recommended_fix: Amend the AGENTS.md fixed-tick bullet to the r2 ruling: sim rate owned by the FPPSimDriver accumulator; bUseFixedFrameRate=False; FixedFrameRate=20 is documentation only.

title: PacketPlumberCoreTests now hosts game-module tests — module name no longer matches scope
evidence: Build.cs additions: '"PacketPlumber", / "EnhancedInput", / "InputCore", / "UMG",'. The module's tests now include PPInputTests.cpp (APPRunPlayerController/APPRunGameMode), PPViewGeometryTests.cpp (PPViewGeometry.h, PPCommandBus), PPSimDriverTests.cpp (FPPSimDriver). uproject: PacketPlumberCoreTests Type 'UncookedOnly'.
detail: Dependency direction is sound (tests at the edge, UncookedOnly keeps cooked builds clean), but 'CoreTests' accumulating input/UMG/driver tests misleads future slices hunting where sim-spine coverage lives versus view/input coverage.
recommended_fix: Rename in a later slice (PacketPlumberTests) or add a Build.cs comment: single automation module for all runtime layers — Core spine, PacketPlumber view/input.

title: Input binding leg binds the test seams, not the controller's production delegates
evidence: PPInputTests.cpp:77-78: 'EIC->BindAction(PC->GetDrawStartAction(), ETriggerEvent::Started, PC, &APPRunPlayerController::FireDrawStartForTest);'. Production PPRunPlayerController.cpp:54: 'EIC->BindAction(DrawStartAction, ETriggerEvent::Started, this, &APPRunPlayerController::OnDrawStart);'.
detail: The synthesized binding proves Execute() dispatch on constructor-created assets, but the production SetupInputComponent→OnDrawStart→GetMousePosition chain is never exercised headless; a regression there is PIE-only visible.
recommended_fix: State the PIE-only residual in the test comment, or route the production delegates through the seams so the binding leg can bind OnDrawStart/OnDrawEnd directly.

title: PPInputTests hardcodes hand-derived screen coords instead of deriving them via MakeScreenFit
evidence: PPInputTests.cpp:86-91: '// the router's (design-reference 1280x720 fit: source grid(2,2) -> / // x=160+2.5*26*0.9231=220, router grid(6,2) -> x=160+6.5*26*0.9231=316). / const FVector2D SourceScreen(220.f, 62.f); / const FVector2D RouterScreen(316.f, 62.f);'. Sibling PPViewGeometryTests.cpp derives via 'const FPPScreenFit Fit = MakeScreenFit(FVector2D(1280.f, 720.f));'.
detail: The magic numbers hand-re-derive the fit mapping already encoded in PPViewGeometry; the same module holds both styles. Any fit/design-resolution change breaks this test for a non-sim reason with a non-obvious root cause.
recommended_fix: Compute the coords: const FPPScreenFit Fit = MakeScreenFit(FVector2D(1280,720)); Fit.GridToScreen(PP::FIntPoint{2,2}) — same pattern as PPViewGeometryTests.
